library_preparation_preflight.summary: Pure protocol/message library (OAuth2/OIDC request-response construction, JWT/JWK validation, PKCE) with no external service dependency; all required deps are pulled transitively and the standard generated test scaffold (in-memory, no network) mirrors the existing com.nimbusds:nimbus-jose-jwt pattern already in this repo.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Write self-contained, in-memory tests (build AuthorizationRequest/TokenRequest, parse/serialize responses, validate ID tokens against a locally constructed JWKSet, exercise PKCECodeVerifier/State/Nonce/ClientAuthentication) rather than resolving a real OIDC provider or making live HTTP calls (e.g. avoid OIDCProviderMetadata.resolve(issuer) or TokenRequest.toHTTPRequest().send() against a real endpoint), since no mock server or Docker image is being provisioned. Optional library features gated behind BouncyCastle/Tink/OpenSAML are out of scope for the smoke-level scaffold.
risks: If a reviewer wants coverage of OpenSAML-based SAML 2.0 bearer grant support or Tink-based encryption, that would require adding the corresponding optional dependency — but this isn't part of mainstream OAuth2/OIDC usage and shouldn't block initial support.
